paraphrase: To the dying Anāthapiṇḍika Sāriputta teaches: 'I will not cling to the eye and my consciousness will not be dependent on the eye' — and so for all senses, objects, consciousnesses, contacts, feelings, elements, aggregates, formless spheres, this world and the next, and whatever is seen, heard, sensed, cognised; Anāthapiṇḍika weeps, never having heard such a talk, which is usually not given to lay people.
